title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the DeLorean
description:
The DeLorean DMC-12 launched at twenty-five thousand dollars, and its name was supposed to tell you the price. Its shiny stainless steel body is not what holds the car together. Those are the two things we explain in this video. Roughly nine thousand were built, and about six and a half thousand were still on the road in twenty fifteen. Every figure here comes from a named source. We used Wikipedia's pages on the DMC DeLorean, on John DeLorean and on DeLorean Motor Company of Texas, plus Business Insider, Yahoo Autos and ThePricer. Wikipedia's own figures sometimes disagree with each other, and we show where. Our own arithmetic is labelled as ours.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
